items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed ruled out by team/Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in HOU offense; Schultz becomes primary pass-catcher.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets for remaining pass-catchers especially TE.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals; Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder). Coach: Warren will lead the group with breathers as needed.
items.why: Toe injury; official ruled out. Warren shoulder but expected lead.
items.implication: Warren elevated to clear lead back; checkdown volume likely with Rodgers vertical struggling.
items.opportunity: Warren snaps/carries/routes surge; practice squad Homer and rookie Heidenreich as backups.

items.text: Puka Nacua will not practice and is doubtful vs Broncos (hip); McVay believes barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip; no practice Friday, coach comments.
items.implication: Likely miss Week 3; Adams and others absorb routes/targets. Return timeline next week positive.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for Davante Adams and LAR pass-catchers.

items.text: With Dowdle out, expect Jaylen Warren lead role; vertical pass game failing for Rodgers so spam checkdowns to Warren. Backups: Homer (PS callup) and rookie Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comments + Rodgers inefficiency; opportunity expansion.
items.implication: Warren strong RB2/flex with volume; handcuff value on backups low.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, checkdown targets, third-down work.

items.text: Packers first game without Jayden Reed: Christian Watson 45 routes, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.implication: Watson/Golden clear WR1/2 opportunity; sustained high involvement.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, red-zone share elevated without Reed.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR; week-to-week after elbow imaging/specialists, aiming return ASAP. Out this week vs Seahawks only for now.
items.why: Dislocated elbow imaging positive; consensus not IR.
items.implication: Positive long-term; short-term out boosts backups/Mariota for WAS pass-catchers like McLaurin short-term only.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back upgrade ROS short-term.

items.text: Berry loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Collins out; Colts allow 4th-most yards to TEs.
Kyle Pitts only 63% route participation, six targets (8% share) through three games. TPRR last two seasons: 33% with London off, 17% with London on.
items.why: Low route/target share data; dependent on London absence.
items.implication: Fade Pitts in full London games; limited TE1 upside currently.
items.opportunity: Only spikes if London off field.

items.text: Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 YPG.
items.opportunity: Carries, goal-line work vs weak run D.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush YPG to RBs.
Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps and 5 touches after fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush YPG to RBs (3.2 YPC).
items.implication: Sit; Henderson narrowed gap but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead of Henderson.

items.text: Berry hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest fantasy pts to WRs, 7.9 YPR allowed; WAS lowest implied total (17). Daniels out but Mariota history not fully tanking.
items.why: Brutal matchup + low team total; Daniels absence.
items.opportunity: 25% tgt share historically with Mariota but tough spot.
